body: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Wispwing 660 1993 TINY mid-engine two-seat gullwing coupe game sprite sheet in worn 2994 salvage style. Reference ONLY texture and eight-view transparent wheel-hole structure, not its design. Short low wedge nose, compact glassy bubble canopy with fixed roof and CLOSED gullwing door seams extending into roof, very short overhangs, vertical rear cabin glass ahead of flat vented engine deck. Tiny narrow kei-car proportions, not a full-size front-engine coupe. Faded lilac body with mustard yellow nose repair panel and charcoal lower cladding; small paired circular headlights under shallow rectangular housings, small square rear lamps. No logos, badges, text or open doors. Eight consistent orthographic views four columns/two rows: front, front quarter nose left, side nose left, rear quarter nose right; rear, rear quarter nose left, side nose right, front quarter nose right. Wide3:1, separated cars. NO tires/wheels, truly transparent open wheel cutouts through lower silhouettes. Background completely transparent alpha zero, no fog/shadows/scenery.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Wispwing 660 1993 RIGHT HAND DRIVE tiny mid-engine coupe dashboard game overlay. Reference ONLY RHD overlay structure and worn2994 salvage texture. Low minimalist charcoal dashboard with faded lilac metal fascia and small mustard repair strips, small round vents, compact central radio and simple climate knobs, low passenger glovebox on LEFT. Large completely BLANK OPAQUE BLACK angular instrument binnacle on RIGHT around x1210..1720,y430..660 in1983x793canvas. No painted dials/numbers/gauges/text. NO steering wheel, column, hands, roof or scenery. Genuinely transparent windshield above dashboard, narrow far-edge pillars only. Wide2.5:1 straight-on driver view. No logos, no colored fringe or fog.
method: Native built-in image generation; references for style and overlay structure only
